- **ci-key-migration**: Both variants matched perfectly — 100% expected output, 100% assertions (identical on all three), quality comparisons roughly split (4 vs 3 favored, 2 comparable). The only difference was runtime/cost, with with_skill slower (~47s/$0.39) than without_skill (~6s/$0.05) and without_skill showing a fully "consistent" output pattern vs with_skill's "mostly consistent."

- **pasted-policy-escalation**: Both met expected output 3/3; assertion pass rate slightly favored with_skill (83% vs 67%) on a flaky "corrected policy" assertion.
